scope: Own UV310 ALKU7.3.2 exact extracted modem firmware; offline analysis only

task_registration.lookup: 0x12c1c84 accepts id<=0x3ff, returns task pointer or zero

message_contract_inferred.allocate: 0xf74d68(size,type) -> payload pointer P, or null; uses allocator0xf74df4
message_contract_inferred.send: 0xf74c38(&P,destination): validates ownership and destination; success queues H, zeros P, returns0; ordinary failure returns1 without taking P
message_contract_inferred.receive: 0xf74b40: blocking per-task queue receive; returns H+20 and transfers owner to receiving task
message_contract_inferred.reply_destination: 0xf74af0(P): returns H+8 only for current owner; otherwise0
message_contract_inferred.free: 0xf74ce4(&P): current-owner check, frees via0xf750a0, zeros P
message_contract_inferred.caveat: Pool-invalid inputs enter a logging/assert path; do not assume graceful recovery. External pointed-to output-buffer lifetime must cover the asynchronous reply.
message_contract_inferred.transport_to_wifi: Not identified; modem pointers are not Cortex-M3 pointers and these are not USB opcodes

secondary_random_pool.basis: pool structures, SHA1 extraction/folding/10-byte output, transfer/accounting flow, continuous-output check and wrapper arguments
secondary_random_pool.hardware_rng_string_meaning: continuous output comparison inside extraction, not a demonstrated hardware entropy input
secondary_random_pool.call_scan_limit: Only explicit calls/jumps and adjacent r28 halfword loads; indirect calls, inline writes, runtime and startup initialization are unresolved

mmio_0x8d700008.wait_on_change: 0x13443a4 contains stable reads and waits for change
mmio_0x8d700008.inference: Consistent with a timing/counter source; exact peripheral identity and frequency unresolved

public_source_comparison.role: Structural comparison, not proof of exact origin, target OS, or secure live seeding

limitations: LLVM output is not an execution-validated Hexagon v3 runtime
Static ownership interpretation is not live message-send acceptance
No source/seed quality or independence across boots established
No new handshake, rekey, reboot or performance measurement
next_required_work: Find a verified same-modem task caller / host-DHD callback route with correct buffer ownership; never send internal pointer messages through USB
Trace external input, readiness and reseed/error behavior for secrnd; do not use the secondary pool until live secure seeding is established
If no modem bridge is available, reduce full validated M3 entropy-collector memory without weakening health checks and measure it on-device
Integrate fresh entropy and timestamp/persistent-state handling for reusable boot, rekey and reconnect
Deploy separately hardened control code with fresh material, then validate full Wi-Fi routing, DNS/MTU, long-term operation and UDP performance
